about: The makers a liquor shelf fragment may name, as its producer field and in its prose: each the company or distillery that makes the bottle, as its own site names it, never the brand's current owner or parent group (style.txt, FACTS). An author adds a maker only from the producer's own page or two independent sources, and corrects a name here when the producer's page spells it otherwise. A name here is a business, never a person.
